title: Concept of 'As'
theory:
 "As" is used after certain verbs to indicate the role, identity, or function of a person or
        thing. However, after some verbs, the use of "as" is generally omitted and should be
        avoided.

              Use "as" after the following Verbs:
        		 regard, describe, define, treat, view, know, portray

              Do not use "as" after the following Verbs:
        		 name, elect, think, consider, call, appoint, make, choose, declare
